enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink. Open dishwasher. Place bowl in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table.

Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take notes. Wash hands. Walk to next patient. Check IV drip. Adjust bed. Talk to patient. Wash hands. Walk to nurse station. Enter notes into computer. Answer phone.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Walk outside. Sit on bench. Look at phone. Walk back to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Clock in. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Listen to heart. Check oxygen level. Administer medication. Take notes. Wash hands. Walk to next patient. Assist with mobility. Talk to patient. Wash hands. Walk to nurse station. Update records. Answer phone. Consult with doctor.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Take out pan. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Cook. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer in air-conditioned room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Close laptop. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Return. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to other side. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.
